summary: Iter138 — WKQ Skybound v3 (3-chapter) verification. BACKEND: 9/9 pytest GREEN in /app/backend/tests/test_iter138_wkq_skybound_v3.py (junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter138.xml): (1) GET /api/realm-keys/registry?game_id=wkq-skybound-chef-v2 returns exactly 3 active keys with level_index 0,1,2 and every key has art.runtime_url set. (2) POST /api/realm-keys/award for level_index 0/1/2 on a fresh throwaway user awards exactly once ({awarded:true, already_owned:false}) then correctly returns {awarded:false, already_owned:true} on repeat. (3) POST /api/realm-keys/award with level_index=7 returns 404 (route validates via registry lookup). (4) GET /api/realm-keys/mine lists the 3 awarded keys. (5) GET /api/games/wkq-skybound-chef-v2/fire-info as founder → {enabled:true, rewards.final_completion:10000, rewards.completion:0} — HONEST reward config, no per-stage completion drip. (6) POST /api/games/wkq-skybound-chef-v2/score {completed:true} — 'Game completed' label absent on repeat call (idempotent gfp:final key). FRONTEND E2E (stealth founder, /games?play=wkq-skybound-chef-v2): (a) iframe [data-testid=game-runtime-iframe] mounted; splash 'ORAi PRESENTS · World Kitchen Quest: Skybound Chef' visible. After Enter, HUD renders 'Stage 1/3 · Score 0 · ♥♥♥ · Sky Harbor Market' plus quest label 'Find the Emerald Realm Key' — EXACT match to spec. (b) Fire-info banner reads literally '🔥 Fire Power rewards — server-verified · Finish +10,000 (once per player)' — no legacy 'Fire available' pool banner. (c) Chapter 1 renders REAL painted art (screenshot iter138_key_final.png): Sky Harbor panorama background, wooden dock platform textures, wooden crate platforms at 500/760/1020/1240 x-positions, cyan Emerald Realm Key gem shining on top crate at (1240,545), Aurora hero sprite (dark ponytail, cyan outfit) mid-jump — ZERO placeholder gray boxes, ZERO checkerboards (canvas is CORS-tainted proving external image assets are loaded). (d) window.__GBGEO__ matches v3 seed spec exactly: world [3600,1000], solids [{0,880 3600x60 ground},{500,780 180x40},{760,700 160x40},{1020,620 160x40},{1240,545 200x40}]; keys [{ch1_emerald_key at 1350,505}]; portals [{ch1_gate at 3450,880}]. (e) Real page.keyboard drives runtime: ArrowRight moved Aurora x=90→2750 across multiple runs; ArrowUp/W trigger jump (state transitions idle→jump_rise→jump_fall→land observed); portals[0].state=='locked' verified before key pickup at multiple x positions. (f) Fullscreen toggle [data-testid=game-fullscreen-toggle] activates NATIVE Fullscreen API — document.fullscreenElement becomes the shell DIV, iframe remains visible. (g) No uncaught JS console errors (only pre-existing 401/403 on optional anon endpoints — acceptable per task note). NOT proven end-to-end within playwright: actual key pickup toast 'Got the Emerald Realm Key' and full Ch1→Ch2 stage advance — same platforming-precision friction as iter137 (scripted keyboard bursts can't reliably chain the crate hops A→B→C→D up to y=505 within the jump-arc timing window). However all constituent components are individually proven and the backend award idempotency is fully tested via pytest.
action_items: OPTIONAL (not blocking): expose window.__GB__.grantKey() / teleport(x,y) or a ?debug=1 stage-skip so automated regression can prove full Ch1→Ch2→Ch3 traversal. Same request from iter137 stands — pixel-perfect crate-hop timing exceeds scripted-keyboard reliability. Backend award is fully covered by pytest so this is only a coverage-completeness item, not a functional bug.
critical_code_review_comments: realm_keys.py is CLEAN and correct: server-authoritative (browser cannot supply key_id/series/amount), idempotent via {user_id,key_id} upsert with $setOnInsert, correct 404 on unknown level, 400 on non-integer level_index, MongoDB _id excluded from all responses via {_id:0} projection.

games_plus.py /fire-info returns HONEST payload — no pool availability, only server-verified reward schedule. rewards.completion=0 + rewards.final_completion=10000 for wkq-skybound-chef-v2 matches spec.
games_plus.py score submit finale reward uses idempotency key `gfp:final:{game_id}:{uid}` — cannot be re-granted. Verified via double-submit test.

GamesHub.jsx line 198 fire-info block correctly hides the 'X Fire available' pool banner and only shows server-verified rewards summary. Text formatting includes toLocaleString for the 10,000 finale amount ('+10,000 (once per player)') — good UX.

GameRuntime.jsx line 3281 realm_level_complete postMessage → /api/realm-keys/award POST is straight-through and non-guessable (only game_id + level_index sent, key metadata comes from server registry). Correct trust boundary.
Fullscreen toggle uses browser-native Fullscreen API (document.fullscreenElement) rather than CSS-only fixed positioning; iframe stays visible in FS. Works on Chromium as tested.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 pytest — registry, award x3 levels, invalid level 404, mine listing, fire-info 10000, finale idempotency)
success_rate.frontend: Chapter 1 core visuals + mechanics 100% proven (real painted art, HUD Stage 1/3, quest label, __GBGEO__ v3 layout, keyboard-driven movement/jump, portal locked-state, fire-info banner exact text, fullscreen toggle, zero uncaught errors). Full C1→C2→C3 traversal not proven in automation due to platforming-precision limits — see action_items.
